source.evidence: 15 specimens: existing-geometry delta audit, current high-fidelity contexts and screenshots for additions and changed shadows, exact new icon leaves

boundaries: Source explicitly describes static Default and Hover appearances and no wired hover or slide navigation.
Every slide/thumbnail fill uses the same Windows Bloom placeholder, not Alaska or portrait photography. Downloaded image SHA256 exactly matches existing fy25 asset.

Bottom arrows and Top bars strips have five frames: four normal images then a See more overlay. Bottom arrows label reads 1 of 4; Top bars has four indicators. Handling the extra panel is not defined by source.
Badge collection count 24 or 23 differs from four preview thumbnail/indicator slots.
3:4 arrows/top-bars metadata exists at negative X but is completely clipped. Preserve the visible design.
Alice Regular was downloaded from pinned Fontsource 5.2.6 under OFL; Figma does not expose its original font binary for identity comparison.
Code Connect imports point to unavailable Windows entity-segments source paths. Exact leaf assets were extracted; mappings and source artwork were not modified.
Manual runtime controls, keyboard support and hover behavior are implementation decisions, not claims about wired Figma behavior.
Historical screenshots from 2026-11-09 include former outer shadow bounds. Current updated variants reference 2026-11-11 captures. All screenshots are evidence only, never runtime artwork.
The 2026-11-11 capture removes outer shadows from every card.
Bottom bars + arrows has five indicators for four image slots and the See more end card. Only Default is supplied; it has no thumbnail-hover appearance.

New footer uses a 90px slot, 24px padding, 28px soft arrows, 6px full-width indicators and a one-line Roboto Bold 14/22 title. The returned design context approximates progressive source blur with 2.5px backdrop blur.

sourceCounter.note: The fifth See more panel exists offscreen; source has no navigation behavior.
